name: acs-cymru-asset-tracking
description: ACS-Cymru Asset Tracking Platform (Supabase BaaS + Standalone TimescaleDB)

scripts.//test:lib: Explicit file paths, NOT `node --test scripts/lib/`: the directory form's discovery behaves differently on Windows and reports the directory itself as one failing test.
scripts.//test:db: The database suites against a THROWAWAY Postgres, not the live stack. They default to port 54322, which is where docker-compose publishes production -- and their committed fixtures leave permanent rows in the append-only digital_thread. Needs Docker and nothing else; --keep leaves the container up.
scripts.//test:py: Every Python suite in a LANE, discovered from the tree rather than listed. scripts/python-suites.mjs says which lane each suite is in and why; the runner refuses to run at all if a test_*.py in the tree has no lane, which is what stopped twenty of them running in no job anywhere (#147). `unit` needs nothing. `db` needs the migrated Postgres and is what test:db runs against its throwaway container. `stack` needs the composed stack and runs in e2e.
scripts.//keys: The two principal-bearing service keys (issue #101). check is safe to run anywhere and exits non-zero when one is near expiry; rotate re-signs both in place and names the containers to restart.
